definitions.hd_mean: robust-scaled mean of the frozen Host 24h trajectory, z=(v-center)/scale
definitions.hd_std: within-day population std of the robust-scaled Host trajectory
definitions.hd_iqr: within-day IQR (linear quantiles 0.75-0.25) of the robust-scaled Host trajectory
definitions.hd_spread: max-min of the robust-scaled Host trajectory
definitions.hd_tv: total absolute first difference of the robust-scaled Host trajectory
definitions.hd_max_ramp: maximum absolute hourly first difference of the robust-scaled Host trajectory
definitions.hd_shape_entropy: Shannon entropy (nats) of p=relu(host-min)/sum on the raw Host trajectory
definitions.hd_shape_concentration: max_h p_h of the same relative-Shape view
definitions.hs_mae_med: median over the 7 revealed history days of that day's mean|residual|
definitions.hs_mae_mad: MAD of the same 7 day MAEs
definitions.hs_absb_med: median over the 7 days of |b_j| (exact geometry through core.geometry)
definitions.hs_logB_med: median over the 7 days of log1p(B_j / s_B), s_B the frozen TRAIN mass scale
definitions.hs_logB_mad: MAD of the same 7 log1p(B_j / s_B)
definitions.hs_qL_med: median over the 7 days of the Level share q_L = H|b_j| / ||r_j||_1
definitions.hs_qB_med: median over the 7 days of the balanced share q_B = 2B_j / ||r_j||_1
definitions.hs_trend_b: OLS slope of b_j against the chronological index 0..6 within the window
definitions.hs_trend_logB: OLS slope of log1p(B_j/s_B) against the same index
definitions.hs_signchange_med: median over the 7 days of the residual sign-change count (zero hours skipped)
definitions.hs_coh_pos: median over the 7 days of W1(s+_j, mass-weighted barycentre of the historical s+)
definitions.hs_coh_neg: median over the 7 days of W1(s-_j, mass-weighted barycentre of the historical s-)
definitions.hs_mae_iqr: IQR of the 7 day MAEs (the registered dispersion of day MAE)
definitions.hs_b_iqr: IQR of the 7 b_j (the registered dispersion of b)
definitions.hs_B_iqr: IQR of the 7 B_j (the registered dispersion of B)

allowed_inputs: current frozen Host 24h trajectory for the target day
the W=7 fully revealed historical residual days already carried by the target row (shadow-OOF TRAIN provenance, or prequential earlier-VAL provenance)
frozen TRAIN-only scales: host RobustScaler(center, scale) and CoordinateScales.s_B
forbidden_inputs_absent_by_construction: any statistic computed from the target day's realized residual or from a model output
legality.seed_dependence: none: build_cell_data takes no seed and every descriptor is a function of frozen evidence fields; repair_r1 verifies the seed-invariant R0 atlas columns agree across the three seeds for every (cell, day) before deduplicating.

analogue_test_registration.absolute_view: L1 over the frozen robust-scaled 24h Host trajectory
analogue_test_registration.relative_view: 1 - cosine between the nonnegative normalised Host Shape views
analogue_test_registration.K: argmin over exactly the 7 revealed history days; no K search
analogue_test_registration.summary_reference_primary: uniform mean over the 7 history days
analogue_test_registration.summary_reference_secondary: mass-weighted mean, weights = the history day's ||r_j||_1
analogue_test_registration.oracle_reference: argmin over the 7 history days of that metric's own distance; target-aware upper bound only, never a deployable selector
analogue_test_registration.frac_headroom_recovered: (err_summary_uniform - err_legal) / (err_summary_uniform - err_oracle), defined only when the denominator exceeds 1e-9

metric_units.shape_dist: target-mass-weighted W1, weights = the target day's P and N

association_reported: rho_perday_median: median over days of the within-day Spearman over the 7 pairs
rho_pooled_7xN: Spearman over all 7*N pairs pooled
